{{Quote|I'm pleased to meet you, but if you don't mind, I'm trying to enjoy the music. Perhaps we can talk once the band wraps up.|Mu Namb, to fellow guests at Duke Piddock's party|<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
'''Mu Nanb''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nanb journeyed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] where he attended a party held by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]] of the [[Gogum Hive]] on a mission to broker a weapons deal on behalf of the Alliance. During the party Nanb sat on his own and did not mingle with the other guests and he tried to conceal the try purpose of his mission by operating under a cover story that he was a tourist from [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullust]] who had bonded with Piddock over a shared appreciate of [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] music.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />

==Personality and traits==
Namb was a shy individual who was nervous during his mission to meet with Piddock on Geonosis. He supported the Rebel Alliance and passionately disliked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] because of their [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and their persecution of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]][[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
